title: Holiday Fares Spike, United Picks a Wi-Fi Fight With Delta, and Vegas Can't Catch a Break
summary: Thanksgiving and Christmas airfares are hitting decade highs as airlines quietly shrink their schedules — we break down why "controlled capacity" is code for higher prices. Plus, United takes a very public shot at Delta over inflight Wi-Fi, flight attendants push back on a "too sick to vacation" memo, and Las Vegas can't figure out why cheaper rooms aren't bringing people back.
